# 图译 Tuyi

> Open-source DWG / DXF translator. Translate text inside CAD drawings. No AutoCAD. Windows and Mac. MIT.

图译 opens a DWG or DXF, translates titles, notes, attributes, dimensions, and table text, then writes a new file. The original drawing is not modified.

## Links

- Home (中文): https://erict16.github.io/tuyi/
- Home (English): https://erict16.github.io/tuyi/en.html
- Source: https://github.com/erict16/tuyi
- Releases: https://github.com/erict16/tuyi/releases/latest
- License: https://github.com/erict16/tuyi/blob/main/LICENSE

## Notes

- DXF works after install. DWG needs ODA File Converter on the same machine; Tuyi does not bundle it.
- Translation keys are yours (DeepL, Azure, Ollama, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Tuyi does not create accounts.
- Default direction is Chinese to English.
